claims.claim: Greater Vancouver Realtors reported 2,024 October home sales, down 10.2 per cent year over year and 22.5 per cent below the 10-year average.

claims.claim: Fraser Valley October sales were 1,051, up 14 per cent from September, and the benchmark was $860,000, down 6.4 per cent year over year.
